description:
Searches the whole standard, every section of every page and every checklist rule, and returns the best matches: where each one is, a short excerpt, and for rules, their ID, level and scope.

WHEN TO USE: to find where a topic is covered when you don't know the page or the section, like "focus after delete", "spinner", "aria-pressed" or "dark mode". Then read a section with get-page, or rules with list-rules.
WHEN NOT TO USE: to list a component's rules, use list-rules. To see which components there are, use list-components.

Search for a few specific words rather than a whole question.

component.description: Only search this page and its rules, like button or design-tokens.

limit.description: How many results to return, at most.

query.description: A few words, like "focus after delete" or "aria-pressed".

type.description: Only search sections, or only rules.

name: search-docs

anchor.description: The section, for get-page's sections. A rule's is its checklist table: the sections that explain it are results of their own.

title.description: The section's heading, or the rule's ID.

total.description: How many sections and rules match, of which the best come first.

title: Search Docs
